en:
## New Features

- **Customizable narrator toolbar**: the title-bar tool buttons are now registry-driven, reorderable by drag, and collapsible into an overflow menu — your layout persists across sessions
- **Mobile tool panels**: git, search, browser and chat rooms are now reachable on mobile through a full-screen drawer. They previously did not exist at all without a dock, rather than merely being collapsed
- **Recent tabs grouped by directory**: narrators sharing a working directory fold into one row with the path written once, while still summarizing the running and pending state inside. Touch users get a swipe-left gesture to pin
- **Third-party licenses page now covers every distributed component** (~1180 entries) instead of only direct dependencies — including the Bun runtime, the bundled zstd binary, musl libc, Go modules and platform-native `.node` files, none of which live in `node_modules`. Full texts load on demand, shrinking the page bundle from 1.7 MB to 7.6 KB

## Bug Fixes

- **Tool-heavy turns no longer stall silently mid-stream.** Outbound requests forced `Connection: close`, disabling connection reuse, so every tool round rebuilt a TCP+TLS connection and was more likely to land on a forwarding hop that accepts a connection but never delivers the request. Measured across two weeks of gateway traffic, silent-failure rate went from 0.67% to 2.58% when that header was introduced; it has been removed. The stall itself originates upstream — this removes the amplifier, and adds a warning log so the remaining cases are visible instead of invisible
- **Feedback typed when rejecting a plan is shown again.** On the new message renderer it was dropped entirely, so the one thing a reviewer wrote had no outlet and no error. It now appears above the plan body in yellow, matching the classic card — and an approved plan no longer grows a spurious rejection notice from the same field
- **Large API request dumps spill to disk** instead of being truncated into the database row, so downloading a dump gives the whole thing rather than a preview. Absolute paths are stripped from anything returned inline, since dumps get forwarded to people helping diagnose
- Images in the message list reserve height from their real dimensions, so the conversation no longer reflows as pictures load. Dimensions reported by a remote server are sanitized first
- A hard quota `429` is no longer retried forever: `retry-after` says when to retry, not whether the failure is transient, and a weekly usage wall was sending back a 4.3-day value
- WebSocket recovery after a tab returns from the background no longer relies on `visibilitychange` alone, which is unreliable across bfcache, freeze/resume and iOS
- Cross-surface drags only show drop indicators on surfaces that can actually accept them — a single-narrator dock used to light up for a drop that could never land there
- Archive creation for file sharing now has a timeout and bounded error output, so a stuck network mount or a symlink loop cannot hang a narrator indefinitely
- The branch name in the chapter bar and Git panel is now selectable and copyable, with a one-click copy button and the short HEAD sha alongside it
zh-CN:
## 新功能

- **叙述者工具栏可定制**：标题栏的工具按钮改为注册表驱动，可拖拽排序、收纳进溢出菜单，布局会持久保存
- **移动端补齐工具入口**：git、搜索、浏览器与讨论室现在可通过全屏抽屉打开。此前没有停靠区时这些入口不是折叠，而是根本不存在
- **最近标签按目录聚合**：同一工作目录下的叙述者折叠为一行，路径只写一次，折叠时仍汇总内部的运行与待处理状态。触屏新增左滑置顶手势
- **第三方协议页面覆盖全部分发组件**（约 1180 条），不再只列直接依赖 —— 包含 Bun 运行时、随产物分发的 zstd 二进制、musl libc、Go 模块以及各平台原生 `.node`，它们都不在 `node_modules` 里。协议全文改为按需加载，页面体积从 1.7 MB 降到 7.6 KB

## 修复

- **工具密集的回合不再中途静默卡住。** 出站请求此前强制 `Connection: close`，禁用了连接复用，于是每轮工具都要重建 TCP+TLS 连接，更容易落到"接受连接但不投递请求"的转发跳上。按两周网关流量统计，该头引入后静默失败率从 0.67% 升到 2.58%，现已移除。静默本身发生在上游，本次消除的是放大器，并补了一条日志让剩余情况可见
- **拒绝计划时写的反馈重新显示。** 在新消息渲染路径上它此前完全消失，审阅者写的唯一一句话既没有出口也没有报错。现在按经典卡片的样式涂黄显示在计划正文上方；同时被批准的计划不会再从同一字段长出一段莫须有的"拒绝反馈"
- **超大的 API request dump 改为落盘**，不再被截断塞进数据库行，下载时拿到的是完整内容而非预览。任何内联返回的数据都会先剥掉绝对路径 —— dump 常被转发给协助排查的人
- 消息列表里的图片按真实尺寸预留高度，加载时对话不再跳动。远端声明的尺寸会先做校验
- 硬配额的 `429` 不再被无限重试：`retry-after` 只说明何时可以再试，并不说明失败是否瞬时，而周用量墙返回的是 4.3 天
- 标签页从后台切回时的 WebSocket 恢复不再只依赖 `visibilitychange` —— 它在 bfcache、冻结/恢复与 iOS 上都不可靠
- 跨表面拖拽只在真正能接手的表面显示落点指示 —— 此前单叙述者的停靠区会为一个永远落不进去的拖拽亮起
- 文件分享的打包过程加了超时与错误输出上限，卡住的网络挂载或符号链接环不会再让叙述者无限期挂着
- 章节栏与 Git 面板里的分支名现在可以选中复制，并配了一键复制按钮和短 HEAD sha
